scope: Map the eight approved source bindings into semantic curriculum lanes for Binah without assigning any of the 139 curriculum slots and without authoring HNK payload.

semantic_lanes.name: CONTEXT_PLACE
semantic_lanes.purpose: Source evidence for work/study context or place semantics only; no locative syntax or sentence frame inferred.

semantic_lanes.name: ACTIVITY
semantic_lanes.purpose: Source evidence for study/work activity semantics only; WATCH remains WATCH and no predicate grammar is inferred.

semantic_lanes.name: INTENTION_NEED_PURPOSE
semantic_lanes.purpose: Source evidence for intention, need and destination/purpose semantics only; CANDIDATE/WATCH constraints remain intact and no modal grammar is inferred.

semantic_lanes.name: HABITUALITY_EVIDENCE_ONLY
semantic_lanes.purpose: Preserve SARU as evidence for 'todos os dias / habitualidade' only. It is not an approved translation of 'usually' and does not establish frequency, aspect, tense, word order or morphology.

semantic_target.rule: SARU may inform later review but cannot by itself be equated to 'usually' or authorize a complete HNK structure.
